title: Area Sales Manager
summary: An area sales manager runs sales in a territory of several towns or districts through distributors (wholesale partners who stock and deliver to shops) and a team of field sales officers. The role is common in FMCG, pharma, consumer durables and lending, and reports to a regional or zonal sales manager.
dailyDuties: Travel the territory with sales officers to visit distributors and outlets
Review distributor stock, claims and outstanding payments
Track primary and secondary sales against monthly targets
Plan beats and coverage for new towns and outlets
Coach the field team and review their daily numbers
Report the month's performance to the regional manager

skills.expectation: Appoint, review and replace distributors and track their ROI
Drive primary billing and secondary sales to retail outlets in the area
Plan coverage, beats and expansion across towns in the territory
Collect distributor outstandings and settle claims on time
Run trade schemes within budget and check their ROI
Track targets, secondary sales and distributor stock in Excel
Lead, coach and review a team of sales officers or field executives
Run monthly reviews with the team and report to the regional manager
Break regional targets into monthly plans by distributor
Use a distributor management system or sales app for orders and attendance
Negotiate terms with distributors and large retailers
Handle local modern trade stores in the area
For loan or insurance roles, know the product and DSA channel
Read territory dashboards to spot gaps
